entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: The oldest and tallest tree of the Jukai Forest on Kamigawa, embodied soul of the forest, later compleated by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: City that expanded into Jukai Forest.

entities.name: Okina
entities.description: The greatest temple of the Jukai, near Boseiju.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War before which Boseiju was already two thousand years old.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which the Boseiju District was targeted.

events.summary: Towashi's expansion into Jukai Forest drove out kami, who attacked the new buildings.
events.quote: Enraged, the kami fought back, emerging from the depths of the forest to wreck the newly constructed buildings

events.summary: The emperor brokered an agreement halting Towashi's growth into the forest and forbidding the felling of Boseiju.
events.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

events.summary: Boseiju began to grow again until it eclipsed the city's tallest structures.
events.quote: It grew so large and so tall that it came to eclipse even the tallest structures surrounding it.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Tamiyo corrupted Boseiju and the tree burst apart.
events.quote: Boseiju itself was corrupted by the compleated planeswalker Tamiyo
